description: This Java class implements the strategy for handling DeleteAclEntry commands within the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically managing access control list modifications for 'Thing' entities.

classes.name: DeleteAclEntryStrategy
classes.description: Implements the command strategy for deleting an ACL entry from a Thing, validating permissions, and generating appropriate events and responses.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the delete ACL entry command, extracting the ACL, validating, and returning the result.

methods.name: extractAcl
methods.description: Retrieves the AccessControlList from the Thing if the authorization subject is contained.

methods.name: getDeleteAclEntryResult
methods.description: Performs the removal of permissions, validation, and constructs the result event and response.

methods.name: getAclValidator
methods.description: Creates a validator for the ACL to ensure it meets required permissions.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the entity tag of the previous entity state related to the ACL entry.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Returns an empty optional, indicating no specific next entity tag.
